title: Mini-Apps
subtitle: AI-built web tools you reopen instantly

empty.title: No mini-apps yet
empty.description: Pick "Create mini-app" on the session start page and describe what you need — the AI writes the first version in that conversation, and you publish it into this library from the preview. After that, "Keep iterating" changes it and "Publish" makes the change live. Already wrote a web app? Import it with the button above.

import.title: Import a mini-app
import.intro: Adopt a web app you already wrote. A mini-app serves exactly one self-contained HTML document: CSS and JavaScript belong inside the file, third-party libraries may come from a CDN.
import.webUiOnlyFile: On the web the picker takes a single HTML file; importing a whole folder needs the desktop app.
import.clean: All checks passed — nothing to fix.
import.convertHint: This opens a new conversation: NomiFun gets the findings above and rewrites your app as one self-contained mini-app, which you then publish from the preview.

severity.fatalHint: The import cannot proceed while these stand.
severity.autofixHint: NomiFun repairs this for you during the import — nothing to change.
severity.warningHint: These do not block the import, but they are worth knowing.
severity.otherHint: This build does not know this severity yet, so it is listed as-is.

errors.blockedOnImport: The import was refused: the source changed after it was checked. Handle the findings below and retry.
errors.pickFailed: Could not open the file picker
errors.readFailed: Could not read the file you picked

unknown.title: Unknown check ({{ruleId}})
unknown.fix: This build does not know this rule yet. Update NomiFun to see the explanation, or let a session rewrite the app for you.

empty_payload.title: There is no content
empty_payload.fix: This source holds nothing to judge. Pick a real HTML file, or write the page first.

size_over_limit.title: The document is too large
size_over_limit.fix: The document is {{detail}}, over the 4 MiB limit. Drop the inlined images or data blobs (use a CDN or a link instead) and import again.

not_html.title: This is not an HTML document
not_html.fix: The content reads as a script, a stylesheet or data rather than a page. Pick the app's HTML entry file.

no_root_document.title: No entry page in that folder
no_root_document.fix: The folder has no index.html and no single .html file at its root. Name the entry page index.html, or pick that HTML file directly.

fragment_not_document.title: This is only an HTML fragment
fragment_not_document.fix: There is no html / body shell. NomiFun wraps it into a complete document during the import — nothing for you to change.

local_ref_unsupported.title: It references a local file
local_ref_unsupported.fix: The reference {{detail}} cannot load: a mini-app serves exactly one document, so even a file imported alongside it is not served. Fold it into this single file (paste the CSS/JS in, turn small images into data URIs), or let a session merge it for you.

dev_server_ref.title: It points at a local dev server
dev_server_ref.fix: {{detail}} only resolves while your dev server runs. Replace it with content written into the file, or a publicly reachable CDN URL.

framework_source_entry.title: This is framework source that needs a build
framework_source_entry.fix: A Vue / React / Svelte source entry (e.g. /src/main.ts) has to be bundled first. Build it and import the single-page output, or have a session rewrite it as one file.

server_template_markers.title: It contains server template syntax
server_template_markers.fix: Found the template marker {{detail}}, which only becomes HTML on a server. Import the rendered page, or write the data straight into static HTML.

esm_bare_specifier.title: A module script imports a bare package name
esm_bare_specifier.fix: Importing from a bare name like {{detail}} cannot resolve in a browser. Use the library's full CDN URL, or map it with an importmap.

external_cdn_ref.title: It loads resources from a CDN
external_cdn_ref.fix: Allowed, but it needs the network: the app degrades when offline or when the CDN is unreachable. Write anything critical into the file.

web_storage_use.title: It uses browser storage
web_storage_use.fix: A mini-app runs sandboxed with an opaque origin, so localStorage and friends may throw outright or only last for this session. Wrap every read and write in try/catch and never let core features depend on it.

nested_iframe_embed.title: It embeds another iframe
nested_iframe_embed.fix: A nested iframe inherits the same sandbox and many sites refuse to be framed, so it may render blank. Provide a fallback for when it fails to load.
